verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a law firm, not an AI product/platform offering user-facing data controls; while it uses an internal enterprise AI tool (ChatGD) for attorneys via Azure OpenAI, there is no evidence of any customer-facing 'opt out of training' or data-use control feature. This axis applies to AI product vendors handling user-submitted data for model training, not to a law firm's internal tooling — a category mismatch.
